title: Community, rebuilt around people
items: Community now shows what other Matchday users are picking: each game's community split beside the live model and your own pick.
Make your picks, then submit them together. You can change a pick until kickoff.
A simple leaderboard (This week | Season) and a recent-activity feed sit beside the picks.
Stats that already live on Scorecard and Rankings were removed from Community, so the page is much shorter.
